nodes.label: Bayesian Optimization (Closed-Loop Controller)
nodes.rationale: Four-stage closed-loop controller: Metric Collector -> Fitness Evaluator (multi-objective) -> Bayesian Optimizer -> Policy Injector (hot-reload via PUT /api/v1/config). Three profiles: Profit Maximizer, Throughput Maximizer, Regime Adaptor.

nodes.label: Firefly Algorithm Optimizer (Alternative)
nodes.rationale: Population-based metaheuristic from SSRN-2639019. Faster convergence for high-dimensional parameter spaces. A/B testing candidate against Bayesian optimizer.

nodes.label: Ambiguity Aversion Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Compute uncertainty band instead of single ILI value. If gap between bounds exceeds threshold, mark ILI as UNCERTAIN and suppress signals. WeightOptimizer supports Worst-Case Optimization mode.
